description.value: R.A.D. Cycles is an East Vancouver bike shop established in 2016 in the Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, built around a mission of being the friendliest shop in the city for cyclists of all levels. They offer repair services ranging from flat fixes and tune-ups to accident repair, along with personal bike fitting for new and used bicycles. Touring cyclists will appreciate the standing free-air-and-oil policy and the no-charge repair estimates.
